Comments: Fayda MOSIP-based digital ID has 15M+ enrolled (target 90M by 2027), serving 55 service providers. National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) mandated all banks integrate Fayda (December 2025 mandate, March 2026 deadline). MESOB uses Fayda as authentication backbone.

Comments: Digital Government Strategy 2024-2029 provides a phased roadmap. DE2030 sequences initiatives across 0-3 year and 3-5 year horizons. Ethiopian eGovernment Interoperability Framework (EeGIF) provides governance roadmap.

Comments: Digital Ethiopia 2030 (DE2030) explicitly lists 'national data exchange' as a DPI enabler. Digital Government Strategy and Enterprise Architecture 2024-2029 finalized. Comprehensive strategy covering interoperability, open data, and digital infrastructure.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: MESOB provides both physical one-stop-shop centers and digital access channels. Fayda includes a custodian wallet for those without smartphones. Women are 15% less likely to hold a national ID (a gap the Fayda program is designed to address). Full accessibility provisions not yet documented.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Personal Data Protection Proclamation No. 1321/2024 establishes the Ethiopian Communications Authority (ECA) as data protection regulator. DE2030 principles explicitly include 'Sovereign' and 'Nationally anchored: Safeguarding Ethiopia's data, infrastructure, and digital systems.' Open-source MOSIP stack used for Fayda. Enforcement mechanisms are still being established.

Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: EeGIF includes Regional Cells that operate like Ministry-level Chief Interoperability Officers. MESOB is a federal-level pilot with expansion to regional offices planned. PSNP operates across all regions but digital MIS for data exchange not fully confirmed at sub-national level.
